title: Taiwan Student Medical Check-Up
intro: Medical Check-Ups (MCU) are not only required for domestic purposes but are also commonly required for studying or working abroad. At Amalia Medical Center, we provide two types of Medical Check-Up services for applicants traveling to Taiwan: one for students and one for workers.
diff_body: The basic Medical Check-Up includes blood tests, urinalysis, chest X-ray, and physical examination. For Taiwan Medical Check-Ups, additional examinations include stool examination and MR or MMR vaccination. The required vaccine (MR or MMR) depends on the requirements for each student or worker.
blood_body: TPHA and VDRL are laboratory tests used to determine whether a person is infected with Treponema pallidum, the bacterium that causes syphilis.
urine_body:
Urinalysis is a laboratory examination that uses a urine sample to help identify various health conditions. It is commonly used to diagnose urinary tract disorders, diabetes, kidney disease, and urinary tract infections. This examination may also be required during hospitalization, before surgery, or during pregnancy.

Urinalysis evaluates the color, concentration, and composition of urine. For example, cloudy urine may indicate a urinary tract infection.
stool_body: A stool culture is performed using a stool sample that is cultured on a special medium to identify bacteria present in the digestive tract. If pathogenic bacteria are detected, the examination may be followed by an antibiotic susceptibility test to determine which antibiotics are most effective against the bacteria.
vaccine_body:
Students applying for a Medical Check-Up for Taiwan are required to receive an MR or MMR vaccination.

Both the MR and MMR vaccines are part of the national immunization program. The MR vaccine protects against Measles and Rubella (German Measles), while the MMR vaccine provides protection against Measles, Mumps, and Rubella.

The main difference between the two vaccines is that the MMR vaccine includes protection against Mumps, whereas the MR vaccine does not.

A printed vaccination certificate is provided as proof of MR/MMR vaccination and can be kept as part of the applicant's Medical Check-Up documentation.
howto_title: How to Get a Student Medical Check-Up
howto_body:
Getting your Student Medical Check-Up at Amalia Medical Center is easy.

The Student Medical Check-Up package is available from IDR 800,000, including a printed copy of the examination results. If an MMR vaccination is required, the package costs IDR 1,400,000.

Medical Check-Up results are generally available within 2–3 working days.

Requirements
Please bring the following documents:
req_1: A photocopy of your passport and Indonesian ID card (KTP)
req_2: One recent passport-sized photograph (3 × 4 cm or 4 × 6 cm) with a red or blue background
req_3: Any medical forms provided by your university that need to be completed by the clinic
req_4: Get enough rest, drink plenty of water, and avoid coffee and alcohol before the examination
req_5: Choose Amalia Medical Center for your Taiwan Student Medical Check-Up.
